explanation: The theorem says that positive definite integral lattices of fixed rank and bounded determinant have only finitely many Gram matrices up to choice of basis. The proof rests on `LinearMap.BilinForm.exists_finset_forall_exists_toMatrix_mem`, which is the library's own lemma (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/FiniteClasses.lean), not a Mathlib one. A grep of Mathlib for that name found nothing. A case-insensitive search of Mathlib for Hermite constants, Minkowski reduction and finiteness of class numbers of quadratic forms or lattices also found nothing. Mathlib does not appear to have this finiteness result, and `IntegralLattice` is a definition of the library itself.
